title: Epistemic Alignment: A Mediating Framework for User-LLM Knowledge Delivery

bias_targets.methodology: Thematic analysis of user custom instructions from Reddit and content analysis of model provider policies (OpenAI, Anthropic) to evaluate how systems handle pluralism, diverse perspectives, and excessive neutrality.
Evaluating "frame-dependence" and how well models adapt answers to specific cultural and contextual norms, measured through content analysis of user prompts and AI platform documentation.
Analyzing user strategies and platform policies regarding models' tendencies to overly defer to users or accept user misinformation to maintain agreeableness.
